verdict.rationale: Orb documents an audit trail for subscription/plan changes and lets users preview billing impact before saving edits, which offers some review/versioning of billing configuration — but this is about pricing/plan changes, not a general 'automations' builder, and there is no evidence of an explicit rollback mechanism. missing for 10: dedicated automation version history, one-click rollback to prior automation state, and evidence this applies beyond subscription/plan edits.
